correctness.rationale: For each center label, the defining leaf and support inequalities give a finite exact arm-state list. With center in {1,2,3}, the unique weight-one arm is support -1 / leaf 2; every arm with another support label costs at least one more and raises the support-sum contribution by at most four. The center closed-neighborhood inequality therefore gives sharp exceptional-arm counts. Center -1 forces every arm to weight at least two. Equality conditions yield exactly the stated optimizer types. Full-label brute force for q=4,5 and an exact state DP for q=4..60 confirm the theorem.

value.rationale: The foundational paper chose T_{4k} as its principal infinite witness separating signed double Italian from signed double Roman domination, but left its signed double Italian value as a one-sided construction. Proving that construction optimal, extending it to every arm count, and classifying/counting every optimum closes a natural explicit gap in the source rather than introducing an arbitrary family.
